members.bio: Hi! I was the President of the club from June 2021 - June 2023. We have an amazing team here at the CSS Club. I was in charge of leading the club into new levels, like having our first CUNY-wide John Jay Hackathon, growing from 40 members to 540+ members, creating the Club's Website, and having new workshops like React, Python, Swift, MySQL, Git/GitHub, Technical Interview Prep, Javascript, Career Prep , HTML/CSS, Cybersecurity topics, and creating new Assistant Exec Positions, as well as the Web Developer, Data Analytics, Photographer, and Journalist roles. Now, I assist the club as Assistant VP Deputy.
